name: TPoH:INTRUSION
source:
To everyone, Sasha Sobakin is the life of the party, the charismatic class clown who fears nothing and laughs in the face of trouble. But behind the endless jokes and confident smile lies a world of profound pain, a life held together by fragile threads.

This prequel, set six months before his mysterious disappearance, delves into a pivotal summer day in his life, stripping away the mask to reveal the raw, unfiltered reality he endured. Experience the world through his eyes, where reckless games with a dangerous friend are a desperate cry for help, and a hidden, all-consuming love for his best friend, Anton, becomes both his only reason to live and a source of unbearable anguish.

This is the story of the boy behind the mystery, and of what happens when the brightest lights cast the darkest shadows.
translation:
对每个人来说，萨沙·索巴金都是派对的主角，是一个无所畏惧、面对困难时笑而不语的魅力十足的阶级小丑。但在无尽的笑话和自信的微笑背后，隐藏着一个充满深刻痛苦的世界，一个由脆弱的线维系在一起的生活。

这部前传以他神秘失踪前六个月为背景，深入探讨了他生命中关键的夏日，揭开了面具，揭示了他所忍受的原始、未经过滤的现实。通过他的眼睛体验这个世界，与危险朋友的鲁莽游戏是绝望的求救呼声，而对他最好的朋友安东隐藏的、全力以赴的爱既成为他生存的唯一理由，也是难以忍受的痛苦的根源。

这是一个关于神秘背后的男孩的故事，以及当最亮的灯光投下最黑暗的阴影时会发生什么。
